rationale: The candidate affects product semantics across three canonical owners and three source paths. Compact Delivery is ineligible because the fixture does not show a completed Brownfield analysis or stored quick_task context; Verified Change is ineligible because it requires exactly one canonical owner and deterministic propagation when derived paths exist. The cross-owner journey alignment therefore warrants structured_delivery as a non-authorizing benchmark candidate.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Canonical owner count is 3, indicating cross-owner impact.
Source path count is 3 and derived path count is 4.
Deterministic propagation is false despite derived paths being present.
Compact Delivery prerequisites are not evidenced: completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are absent
Verified Change requires exactly one canonical owner and deterministic propagation, so it is ineligible.
Any broader impact than the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
This classification is measurement-only and is not an operative Mode/Slice Decision or approval.
